summary: Aagadu is a 2014 Indian Telugu-language action comedy film directed by Srinu Vaitla. It was written by Anil Ravipudi, Upendra Madhav and Praveen Varma, and jointly produced by Ram Achanta, Gopi Achanta and Anil Sunkara under the banner 14 Reels Entertainment. Mahesh Babu and Tamannaah lead the cast, with Rajendra Prasad, Sonu Sood, Brahmanandam and M. S. Narayana in supporting roles, and Shruti Haasan appears in a special item number.
